roadmap.export.detail: A .zip of Markdown — one file per tree, its guide included. Paste any of them back to replant its steps.
roadmap.export.failed: Couldn't build your export just now — try again.
roadmap.export.title: Your roadmaps
roadmap.plan.canceledNote: Your Windmill One subscription has ended.
roadmap.plan.checkoutFailed: Couldn’t open checkout just now. Try again in a moment.
roadmap.plan.noneNote: Everything you do by hand is free. Automatic Journal echoes are free too. Windmill One is planned for active AI use.
roadmap.plan.pastDueNote: The last payment didn’t go through — Paddle is retrying. Nothing is switched off.
roadmap.plan.pausedNote: Billing is paused, so Windmill One is off for now.
roadmap.plan.title: Plan
roadmap.reminders.noTimezone: This browser won't say which timezone you're in, so we can't pick a decent hour to send. Reminders stay off.
roadmap.reminders.privacy: The email names the tree and up to three of its ready steps, so those titles ride along in ordinary email — and can surface on a lock screen.
roadmap.reminders.saveFailed: Couldn't save just now — try again.
roadmap.reminders.schedule: {day, select, 1 {Mondays around {clock}} 2 {Tuesdays around {clock}} 3 {Wednesdays around {clock}} 4 {Thursdays around {clock}} 5 {Fridays around {clock}} 6 {Saturdays around {clock}} other {Sundays around {clock}}}
roadmap.reminders.sendingOn: Sending on {timezone} time. Every reminder carries a one-tap pause.
roadmap.reminders.suppressedNoRetry: We won't retry on our own. If the address works again, turn reminders back on and we'll write to it — and stop again if that mail comes back too.
roadmap.reminders.suppressedSignIn: Sign-in email is unaffected — magic links still go to this address, so you can always get back in.
roadmap.reminders.suppressedTitle: We can't send reminders to your email address.
roadmap.reminders.suppressedWhy: Mail we sent came back permanently undeliverable, or was reported as spam. Either way we stopped writing to an address that can't receive it, rather than keep trying.
roadmap.reminders.title: Reminders
roadmap.reminders.when: One email a week — {schedule} — and only when a tree of yours has steps ready and you haven't opened Windmill in three days. A busy week means no email; so does a quiet one. And nothing at all in your first week here.
roadmap.tend.notEnabled: AI assistance is unavailable for this account.
roadmap.tend.outOfAllowance: You’ve used this month’s AI request allowance. You can still edit by hand — nothing is gated.
roadmap.tend.outOfBudget: This account has reached its AI ceiling for the last 30 days. You can still edit by hand, and AI assistance returns as that window rolls on.
roadmap.tend.promptTooLong: That’s a lot at once — paste an outline instead for a whole plan.
roadmap.tend.rateLimited: That’s a lot of AI requests quickly. Your tree is exactly as you left it.
roadmap.tend.untouched: Nothing changed — the tree is untouched.
roadmap.tend.untouchedSentenceKept: Nothing changed — the tree is untouched and your sentence is still here.
roadmap.tending.left: {remaining} of {limit} AI requests left this month
roadmap.tending.none: No AI requests yet this month.
roadmap.tending.title: AI assistance
roadmap.tending.used: {used} used · resets {resets}. Hand editing is always free.
